fields.label: Logo
fields.name: logo
fields.instructions: Upload the main site logo displayed in the header. Recommended size: 300x80 px, PNG with transparent background.

fields.label: Logo URL
fields.name: logo_url
fields.instructions: Optional custom URL the logo links to. Leave empty to link to the homepage.

fields.label: Logo list
fields.name: logo_list
fields.instructions: Add additional logos displayed alongside the main logo (e.g. partner brand logos). Each row requires an image and a destination URL.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Logo image for this entry. Recommended size: 200x60 px, PNG with transparent background.

sub_fields.label: URL
sub_fields.name: url
sub_fields.instructions: The page this logo links to when clicked.

fields.label: Page for saved vehicles
fields.name: page_for_saved_vehicles
fields.instructions: Select the page that displays the user's saved/favourite vehicles. Used for the favourites icon link in the header.

fields.label: Show contact bar
fields.name: show_contact_bar
fields.instructions: Enable to display the contact bar at the top of the header. Configure contacts in the Contact list section below.

fields.label: Hide select models
fields.name: hide_select_models
fields.instructions: Enable to hide the model-selector dropdown in the header navigation.

fields.label: Hide favorite icon
fields.name: hide_favorite_icon
fields.instructions: Enable to hide the saved-vehicles (heart) icon from the header.

fields.label: Contact list
fields.name: contact_list_header
fields.instructions: Desktop contact bar items. Each row is one contact entry (e.g. phone number, email, chat link). Visible only when Show contact bar is enabled.

sub_fields.label: SVG icon
sub_fields.name: svg_icon
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the full svg markup for the icon shown next to this contact item.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Label shown next to the icon (e.g. "Call Us" or the phone number).

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Destination when the contact item is clicked (e.g. tel:+15551234567 or mailto:info@dealer.com). Hidden when Show Drop is enabled.

sub_fields.label: Show Drop
sub_fields.name: show_drop
sub_fields.instructions: Enable to show a dropdown panel instead of a direct link. Configure the dropdown items in the Drop tab.

sub_fields.label: Drop
sub_fields.name: drop
sub_fields.instructions: Each row is a section in the dropdown panel. Add a title and a list of items (e.g. department names with phone numbers).

sub_fields.label: SVG icon
sub_fields.name: svg_icon
sub_fields.instructions: Optional SVG icon displayed next to the dropdown section title.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Section heading shown inside the dropdown (e.g. "Sales", "Service").

sub_fields.label: List
sub_fields.name: list
sub_fields.instructions: Items in this dropdown section. First text is typically the label (e.g. department name), Second text is the value (e.g. phone number).

sub_fields.label: First text
sub_fields.name: first_text
sub_fields.instructions: Left column text, typically a department or category label.

sub_fields.label: Second text
sub_fields.name: second_text
sub_fields.instructions: Right column text, typically a phone number or contact detail.

fields.label: Contact list ( mobile )
fields.name: contact_list_header_mobile
fields.instructions: Mobile contact bar items. Same structure as the desktop Contact list but rendered in the mobile menu. Visible only when Show contact bar is enabled.

sub_fields.label: SVG icon
sub_fields.name: svg_icon
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the full svg markup for the icon shown next to this mobile contact item.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Label shown next to the icon in the mobile contact bar.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Destination when the mobile contact item is tapped (e.g. tel:+15551234567). Hidden when Show Drop is enabled.

sub_fields.label: Show Drop
sub_fields.name: show_drop
sub_fields.instructions: Enable to show a dropdown panel instead of a direct link on mobile.

sub_fields.label: Drop
sub_fields.name: drop
sub_fields.instructions: Each row is a section in the mobile dropdown panel with a title and a list of contact items.

sub_fields.label: SVG icon
sub_fields.name: svg_icon
sub_fields.instructions: Optional SVG icon displayed next to the mobile dropdown section title.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Section heading shown inside the mobile dropdown (e.g. "Sales", "Service").

sub_fields.label: First text
sub_fields.name: first_text
sub_fields.instructions: Left column text (e.g. department label).

sub_fields.label: Second text
sub_fields.name: second_text
sub_fields.instructions: Right column text (e.g. phone number or contact detail).

fields.label: Title
fields.name: title
fields.instructions: Site-wide title or dealership name displayed in the header intro area.

fields.label: Information
fields.name: information
fields.instructions: Short tagline or description shown in the header intro area beneath the title.

fields.label: Intro style
fields.name: intro_style
fields.instructions: Layout style for the header intro/hero area. Style 1 is the default layout; Style 2 uses an alternate arrangement.

fields.label: Font
fields.name: font
fields.instructions: Primary font family used site-wide. Changes affect headings and body text across all pages.

fields.label: Theme color
fields.name: theme_color
fields.instructions: Primary brand color used for buttons, links, and accent elements site-wide.

fields.label: Overlay color
fields.name: overlay_color
fields.instructions: Color of the tint overlay applied over hero/banner images.

fields.label: Overlay opacity
fields.name: overlay_opacity
fields.instructions: Opacity of the hero image overlay. Enter a decimal between 0 (transparent) and 1 (fully opaque). Default: 0.75.

fields.label: Header Nav Dropdown Background Color
fields.name: header_nav_drop_bg
fields.instructions: Background color of navigation dropdown panels in the header.

fields.label: Header Nav Link Color
fields.name: header_nav_link_color
fields.instructions: Default text color for navigation links in the header.

fields.label: Header Nav Link Hover Color
fields.name: header_nav_link_hover_color
fields.instructions: Text color of navigation links when hovered over in the header.

fields.label: Menu list
fields.name: menu_list
fields.instructions: Build the header navigation. Use Link for a simple nav item, or Menu to attach a WordPress menu (with dropdown support) under a heading.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Label shown in the header for this menu group (e.g. "Inventory", "Offers").

sub_fields.label: Menu
sub_fields.name: menu
sub_fields.instructions: Select a WordPress menu to display as dropdown items under the Title above.

fields.label: Powered
fields.name: powered
fields.instructions: "Powered by" attribution text displayed in the header or footer (e.g. "Powered by DealerName").

fields.label: Link
fields.name: link_header
fields.instructions: URL for the Powered-by attribution link in the header.

fields.label: Video ID
fields.name: video_id
fields.instructions: YouTube video ID for the header background video (the part after ?v= in the YouTube URL).

fields.label: For script (header)
fields.name: for_script_header
fields.instructions: Custom HTML/JavaScript injected in the <head> section. Use for tracking pixels, Google Tag Manager, or other head scripts.

fields.label: Footer style
fields.name: footer_style
fields.instructions: Layout style for the site footer. Style 1 is the default; Style 2 uses an alternate column arrangement.

fields.label: Copyright
fields.name: copyright
fields.instructions: Copyright text and link displayed in the footer bottom bar (e.g. "© 2025 Dealer Name").

fields.label: Text right side
fields.name: text_right_side
fields.instructions: Text displayed on the right side of the footer bottom bar (e.g. a legal disclaimer or secondary tagline).

fields.label: Form description
fields.name: form_description
fields.instructions: Description text displayed above the footer contact/savings form.

fields.label: Hide search form (footer)
fields.name: hide_search_form_footer
fields.instructions: Enable to hide the vehicle search form from the footer area.

fields.label: Spinning Icon Buttons
fields.name: buttons
fields.instructions: Animated circular icon buttons displayed in the footer. Each row adds one button with an icon, a primary label, a secondary label, and a destination URL.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Icon image for the spinning button. Recommended: square PNG/SVG, at least 80x80 px.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Primary label shown on the button (e.g. "Schedule" or "Call Us").

sub_fields.label: Second text
sub_fields.name: second_text
sub_fields.instructions: Secondary label shown below the primary text on the button (e.g. a brief description or department name).

sub_fields.label: URL
sub_fields.name: url
sub_fields.instructions: Destination URL when the button is clicked.

fields.label: For script (footer)
fields.name: for_script_footer
fields.instructions: Custom HTML/JavaScript injected just before the closing </body> tag. Use for chat widgets, analytics, or other footer scripts.

fields.label: Email notification to
fields.name: email_notification
fields.instructions: Primary recipients for form submission notification emails. Add one email address per row.

fields.label: Email notification cc
fields.name: email_notification_cc
fields.instructions: CC recipients who receive a copy of each form notification email. Add one email address per row.

fields.label: Email notification bcc
fields.name: email_notification_bcc
fields.instructions: BCC recipients who silently receive a copy of each form notification email. Add one email address per row.

fields.label: Unlock Savings Form
fields.name: unlock_savings_form
fields.instructions: Select the WPForms form to display in the footer Unlock Savings / lead-capture section.

fields.label: Contact Savings Form
fields.name: contact_savings_form
fields.instructions: Select the WPForms contact form shown in the footer contact section.

fields.label: ADF Templates
fields.name: adf_templates
fields.instructions: ADF (Auto-lead Data Format) email templates sent to the dealer CRM on form submissions. Each row defines a subject line and the XML/HTML ADF email body.

sub_fields.label: Subject
sub_fields.name: subject
sub_fields.instructions: Email subject line for this ADF notification.
sub_fields.placeholder: e.g. New Lead: Get Price Request

sub_fields.label: Template
sub_fields.name: template
sub_fields.instructions: ADF XML email body. Use standard ADF 1.0 format. Dynamic field tokens (e.g. {{first-name}}) are replaced with submitted form values.

fields.label: ADF Subject Get Price
fields.name: adf_subject_get_price
fields.instructions: Email subject for the Get Price ADF notification sent to the dealer CRM.

fields.label: ADF Templates Get Price
fields.name: adf_templates_get_price

fields.label: Chrome Data API URL
fields.name: url_chromedata
fields.instructions: Base endpoint URL for the Chrome Data (vehicle specifications) API.

fields.label: Chrome Data App ID
fields.name: chromedata_app_id
fields.instructions: Application ID provided by Chrome Data for API authentication.

fields.label: Shared Secret
fields.name: shared_secret
fields.instructions: Shared secret key for Chrome Data API request signing. Keep this confidential.

fields.label: Show Feature list
fields.name: show_feature_list
fields.instructions: Enable to display the Chrome Data vehicle feature list on VDP pages. Configure the features in the Feature list repeater below.

fields.label: Limit feature list
fields.name: limit_feature_list
fields.instructions: Maximum number of feature items to display on the VDP before a Show More button appears. Default: 10.

fields.label: Feature list
fields.name: feature_list_chromedata
fields.instructions: Map Chrome Data feature category IDs to display icons and labels. Each row defines one feature category shown on vehicle detail pages.

sub_fields.label: Chrome Data Category ID
sub_fields.name: id
sub_fields.instructions: Chrome Data feature category ID (numeric). Refer to the Chrome Data API documentation for available category IDs.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Icon displayed next to this feature category. Recommended: square SVG or PNG, 40x40 px.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Display label for this feature category (e.g. "Safety", "Technology", "Comfort").

fields.label: API Key
fields.name: spin_data_api_key
fields.instructions: API key for the 360° spin image provider (Impel, SpinCar, etc.). Provided by your spin image vendor.

fields.label: Evox API key
fields.name: evox_api_key
fields.instructions: API key for the Evox vehicle image service. Obtain from your Evox account dashboard.

fields.label: Evox Product ID
fields.name: evox_productid
fields.instructions: Evox product ID assigned to this account. Provided by Evox when you set up your subscription.

fields.label: Evox Product Type ID
fields.name: evox_producttypeid
fields.instructions: Evox product type identifier that determines the image set format (e.g. exterior, interior). Provided by Evox.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.name: spin_data_id
fields.instructions: Client/dealer ID issued by the 360° spin provider to identify this dealership account.

fields.label: Provider
fields.name: spin_data_provider
fields.instructions: Select the 360° spin image provider used by this dealership. This determines how spin URLs are constructed on VDP pages.

fields.label: URL for CSV (360)
fields.name: url_for_csv_360
fields.instructions: URL to the CSV file containing 360° spin image data for inventory matching. Used by the spin data import process.

fields.label: Shortcodes
fields.name: shortcodes
fields.instructions: Register custom shortcodes that output theme option values. Each row creates a shortcode [sc_NAME] that returns the given value anywhere on the site.

sub_fields.label: Shortcode name
sub_fields.name: shortcode_name
sub_fields.instructions: Example : [sc_dealership_name]

sub_fields.label: Shortcode value
sub_fields.name: shortcode_value
sub_fields.instructions: The text output when the shortcode is used in content (e.g. the actual dealership name).

fields.label: Use new database table
fields.name: use_new_databse_table
fields.instructions: Enable to route API queries through the new optimised database table structure. Only enable after confirming the new table has been populated.

fields.label: Cache API for SRP
fields.name: cache_api
fields.instructions: Enable to cache API responses on the Search Results Page (SRP). Improves performance but may delay showing newly imported inventory. Use transient fields below to control cache keys.

fields.label: Research transient
fields.name: research_transient
fields.instructions: Cache key for post type research

fields.label: Service offers transient
fields.name: service-offers_transient
fields.instructions: Cache key for post type Service offers

fields.label: Listings transient
fields.name: listings_transient
fields.instructions: Cache key for post type listings

fields.label: Used listings transient
fields.name: used-listings_transient
fields.instructions: Cache key for post type Used listings

fields.label: Used listings transient sort
fields.name: used-listings_transient_custom
fields.instructions: Cache key for post type Used listings

fields.label: Offers transient
fields.name: offers_transient
fields.instructions: Cache key for post type Offers

fields.label: Finance offers transient
fields.name: finance-offers_transient
fields.instructions: Cache key for post type Finance offers

fields.label: Lease Offers transient
fields.name: lease-offers_transient
fields.instructions: Cache key for post type Lease Offers

fields.label: Conditional offers transient
fields.name: conditional-offers_transient
fields.instructions: Cache key for post type Conditional offers

fields.label: After import
fields.name: after_import
fields.instructions: Actions triggered automatically after a WP All Import job completes. Each row can ping an action URL or run a WP-CLI command to flush caches or re-sync data.

sub_fields.label: Use
sub_fields.name: use
sub_fields.instructions: Choose how to trigger the post-import action: via an HTTP URL callback or a WP-CLI command.

sub_fields.label: Import ID
sub_fields.name: import_id
sub_fields.instructions: The WP All Import feed/job ID that triggers this action. Find it in WP All Import > All Imports.

sub_fields.label: Action URL
sub_fields.name: action_url
sub_fields.instructions: The URL to ping via HTTP GET after the import finishes (e.g. a cache-flush endpoint).

sub_fields.label: Post type
sub_fields.name: post_type
sub_fields.instructions: The post type to target with the WP-CLI command after this import completes.

fields.label: Smart tags
fields.name: smart_tags
fields.instructions: Map vehicle data fields to WPForms smart tags. Each row selects an ACF/inventory field and its data type so the theme can auto-populate hidden form fields with vehicle data when a form is submitted from a VDP.

sub_fields.label: Field
sub_fields.name: acf_field_selector
sub_fields.instructions: Select the vehicle/offer data field whose value will be injected into WPForms via a smart tag.

sub_fields.label: Field type
sub_fields.name: field_type
sub_fields.instructions: Data type of the field value. "text" passes the raw string; "price" formats the value as a dollar amount.

fields.label: Cookie Modal
fields.name: cookie_modal
fields.instructions: Configure popup modals that appear based on page URL rules and cookie state. Each row is one modal definition. Add content, an optional multi-step flow, and a WPForms form for the final step.

sub_fields.label: Enable Popup
sub_fields.name: enable_popup
sub_fields.instructions: Enable this modal. Disable to temporarily suppress it without deleting the configuration.

sub_fields.label: Cookie name
sub_fields.name: cookie_name
sub_fields.instructions: Unique cookie identifier used to remember that the user has seen or dismissed this popup. Use lowercase letters and underscores only.

sub_fields.label: Cookie Expiration (Days)
sub_fields.name: cookie_expiration_days
sub_fields.instructions: How many days after dismissal before the popup appears again for the same user. Enter a whole number (e.g. 30).

sub_fields.label: Show Only On URLs Containing
sub_fields.name: include_urls
sub_fields.instructions: Comma-separated URL substrings. The popup only appears on pages whose URL contains one of these strings. Leave empty to show on all pages.

sub_fields.label: Exclude URLs Containing
sub_fields.name: exclude_urls
sub_fields.instructions: Comma-separated URL substrings. The popup is suppressed on any page whose URL contains one of these strings.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Heading displayed at the top of the modal popup.

sub_fields.label: Steps
sub_fields.name: steps
sub_fields.instructions: Enable to show a two-step modal flow: Step One shows introductory content with a Next button; the Final Step shows the form. Disable for a single-step modal.

sub_fields.label: Content
sub_fields.name: content_step
sub_fields.instructions: Content displayed on Step One of the multi-step modal before the user clicks Next.

sub_fields.label: Close button
sub_fields.name: close_button
sub_fields.instructions: Styling for the Close/Dismiss button on Step One. Leave fields empty to use theme defaults.

sub_fields.label: Next button
sub_fields.name: next_button
sub_fields.instructions: Styling for the Next button that advances from Step One to the Final Step. Leave fields empty to use theme defaults.

sub_fields.label: Content
sub_fields.name: content
sub_fields.instructions: Content displayed in the Final Step (or the only step for single-step modals), shown above the form.

sub_fields.label: Form
sub_fields.name: form
sub_fields.instructions: Select the WPForms form embedded in the Final Step of this modal.

fields.label: Twilio account sid
fields.name: twilio_account_sid
fields.instructions: Twilio Account SID found in the Twilio Console dashboard. Required for SMS sending.

fields.label: Twilio auth token
fields.name: twilio_auth_token
fields.instructions: Twilio Auth Token from the Twilio Console. Keep this confidential — it authenticates all API requests.

fields.label: Twilio number
fields.name: twilio_number
fields.instructions: Twilio phone number used as the SMS sender (E.164 format, e.g. +15551234567).

fields.label: Active AI
fields.name: active_ai
fields.instructions: Enable the AI chat widget on the front-end. Requires a valid AI Key below.

fields.label: AI crawler
fields.name: ai_crawler_enabled
fields.instructions: Enable the scheduled website content crawler that indexes site pages as AI knowledge base context. Runs daily (full) and every 2 hours (incremental).

fields.label: AI VDP Description
fields.name: ai_vdp_description
fields.instructions: Enable AI VDP Description Population

fields.label: AI Chat Heading
fields.name: heading_ai
fields.instructions: Title shown in the AI chat widget header (e.g. "How can I help you today?").
fields.placeholder: e.g. How can I help you today?

fields.label: AI Key
fields.name: ai_api_key
fields.instructions: OpenAI API key used for the AI chat and embedding features. Obtain from platform.openai.com. Keep this confidential.

fields.label: AI Intent Classifier Prompt
fields.name: ai_intent_promt
fields.instructions: Prompt sent to the AI to classify user intent into one of: INVENTORY, SPECIALS, WEBSITE, FAQ. Use [question] as the placeholder for the user's question.

fields.label: AI inventory prompt
fields.name: ai_inventory_promt
fields.instructions: Supplemental system prompt used when the AI chat handles inventory-related questions. Appended to the main system prompt for vehicle/listing queries.

fields.label: AI Inventory Filter Prompt
fields.name: ai_inventory_filter_promt
fields.instructions: Prompt used to extract structured inventory filters (make, model, price, etc.) from a user question. Use [question] as the placeholder for the user's question.

fields.label: AI Specials Filter Prompt
fields.name: ai_specials_filter_promt
fields.instructions: Prompt used to extract structured specials/offers filters (make, model, offer type, payment range, etc.) from a user question via AI. Use [question] as the placeholder for the user's question.

fields.label: AI Specials Response Prompt
fields.name: ai_specials_promt
fields.instructions: Response generation prompt used when the AI answers specials and offers questions. Placeholders: [specials_context], [question].

fields.label: AI Website Response Prompt
fields.name: ai_website_promt
fields.instructions: Response generation prompt used when the AI answers questions from crawled dealership website content. Placeholders: [website_context], [question].

fields.label: AI FAQ Responce Prompt
fields.name: ai_faq_promt
fields.instructions: Response generation prompt used when the AI answers questions from FAQ. Placeholders: [faq_context], [question].

fields.label: Sales
fields.name: ai_sales
fields.instructions: AI chat escalation panel for the Sales department. Shown in the chat widget as a contact option when the user asks to speak to someone.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Department name shown in the AI chat escalation panel (e.g. "Sales Team").

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: Short description or contact prompt displayed under the department title in the AI chat escalation panel.

sub_fields.label: Form
sub_fields.name: form
sub_fields.instructions: WPForms form shown when a user requests to contact the Sales department from the AI chat widget.

fields.label: Service
fields.name: ai_service
fields.instructions: AI chat escalation panel for the Service department. Shown when the user asks about servicing, repairs, or appointments.

fields.label: Parts
fields.name: ai_parts
fields.instructions: AI chat escalation panel for the Parts department. Shown when the user asks about parts, accessories, or orders.
